settings.scope: Numerical straight path in log partial concentrations. Positive-quadrature entropy consistency and pointwise DGM source integration; no exact multicomponent steady-profile claim. Pure gas constant-T steady flux has a separate exact linear-plus-quadratic concentration potential.

source.name: Cantera 3.2.0 DustyGasTransport original constitutive equations
source.selection: Local isothermal equations only; no source fallback permeability, fraction offset or midpoint face approximation is copied.

permeability_derivation.basis: Poiseuille long circular-tube laminar continuum relation Q = pi*r^4*deltaP/(8*eta*L); divide by tube area, then multiply by bundle porosity to obtain kappa = porosity*r^2/8. Local viscous term only; no claim of finite-length end corrections or exact rarefied flow.

local_law_settings.pore_classification: Declared uniform straight circular-capillary geometry, porosity 0.3 and transport tortuosity 1. Permeability values follow the continuum Poiseuille bundle relation kappa = porosity * radius^2 / 8. This is a model geometry, not measured brick; adding the Knudsen term is the sourced Dusty Gas approximation, not an exact Boltzmann solution.
local_law_settings.scope: Stationary solid frame, ideal dilute gas, common local temperature and supplied positive pore coefficients. No heat equation, thermodiffusion, finite face, changing pore geometry or chemical reaction.

source.author: Dieter Bothe
source.title: On the Maxwell-Stefan approach to multicomponent diffusion
source.scope: Local isothermal isobaric ideal-gas limit. Binary MS diffusivities are friction inputs, not independent Fick coefficients in a mixture.

transport_settings.scope: Pure dilute-gas viscosity and first-order binary molecular diffusion only; explicit zero-dipole LJ approximation. No mixture-viscosity, porous effective diffusivity, Darcy permeability, multicomponent flux, Soret or brick qualification. GRI NASA thermo and reactions are not imported. No post-fit calibration to NIST tables. NIST comparison pressure is unspecified on selected pages; agreement is not pressure-matched experimental validation.
